definitions.explanation: A young cow that has not yet matured. Also written {仔牛|こうし}.

examples.japanese: {牧場|ぼくじょう}で{子牛|こうし}にミルクをやった。
examples.english: I gave milk to a calf at the ranch.

examples.japanese: {母牛|ははうし}は{子牛|こうし}のそばを{離|はな}れようとしなかった。
examples.english: The mother cow would not leave her calf's side.

notes:
A young cow, also written {仔牛|こうし}. Formed from {子|こ} (child) + {牛|うし} (cow), with the reading shifting to こうし.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子牛|こうし}が{生|う}まれる: a calf is born
- {子牛|こうし}を{育|そだ}てる: raise a calf
- {子牛|こうし}{肉|にく}: veal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {牛|うし}: cow; cattle — the general term, regardless of age
